commands: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); SERVER_PID=''; TUNNEL_PID=''; cleanup(){ if [ -n "$TUNNEL_PID" ]; then kill "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if [ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]; then kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; python3 -m http.server 18765 --bind 127.0.0.1 >"$TMP/server.log" 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --url http://127.0.0.1:18765 >"$TMP/tunnel.log" 2>&1 & TUNNEL_PID=$!; URL=''; for i in $(seq 1 60); do URL=$(grep -Eo 'https://[-a-z0-9]+\.trycloudflare\.com' "$TMP/tunnel.log" | head -n 1 || true); [ -n "$URL" ] && break; if ! kill -0 "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null; then cat "$TMP/tunnel.log"; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.5; done; test -n "$URL"; CODE=$(curl -sS -o "$TMP/body" -w '%{http_code}' --retry 5 --retry-delay 1 --max-time 15 "$URL/"); test "$CODE" = 200; grep -q 'Directory listing' "$TMP/body"; echo quick_tunnel_https_reachable=true; echo quick_tunnel_url_shape=trycloudflare_https; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
